about.title: Effective solutions for your company's needs
about.paragraph_1: Atlantic Maritime Agency S.A. represents the prestigious Atlantic Maritime Group in Argentina, an Italian multinational with over 75 years of experience in maritime transport and logistics.
about.paragraph_2: Founded in 1947, the company operates one of the world's largest fleets, connecting more than 150 ports in 50 countries.

services_page.title: Our Logistics Services
services_page.description: We are a shipping agency dedicated to integrated logistics services. We transport cars, rolling cargo, containers, and project cargo to connect Argentina with the world.
services_page.routes_desc_1: Our "multipurpose" vessels are designed for the simultaneous loading of containers, project cargo, and cars.
services_page.routes_desc_2: In Argentina, we operate at Terminal Zárate. From there, we connect with key ports in Brazil, Uruguay, Northwest Africa, and Northern Europe, also offering transshipments to extend our routes.
services_page.team_desc: To request a quote, find the contact person or send your inquiry to the email corresponding to your type of cargo.
services_page.error_loading: Error loading contacts. Please try reloading the page.
services_page.roro_desc: Specialized infrastructure for the safe transport of light and heavy vehicles, and agricultural machinery.
services_page.proyecto_desc: Experts in logistics of oversized pieces for mining, energy, and infrastructure.
services_page.contenedores_desc: Complete container transport service with real-time tracking.
services_page.map_desc: Our network connects Argentina with the world's most important hubs, operating in major ports of the South Atlantic, Northern Europe, West Africa, and Asia.
services_page.team_desc_v2: If you would rather write than fill in the form, each cargo type has its own commercial mailbox.

institutional.title: Be part of Atlantic Maritime Agency
institutional.description: We believe our strength lies in the combination of tradition, excellence, and forward-looking vision. Learn more about our culture and opportunities to grow with us.
institutional.mission_text: To provide comprehensive maritime transport and logistics solutions, connecting Argentina with the world efficiently, reliably, and sustainably, contributing to the development of foreign trade and generating value for our clients, collaborators, and the community.
institutional.vision_text: To be the benchmark in maritime transport solutions in South America, recognized for our operational excellence, technological innovation, and commitment to sustainability, exceeding our clients' expectations in every operation.
institutional.why_desc: We are part of the Atlantic Maritime Group, a multinational leader operating since 1947, recognized for its professionalism and innovation. With over 30 years of presence in Argentina, we have consolidated our local leadership operating with international standards.
institutional.career_desc: Join a leading team in maritime transport. Discover our available vacancies or send us your CV for future opportunities.
institutional.no_vacancies_title: We currently have no active searches.
institutional.no_vacancies_desc: However, if you want to be part of our team, we invite you to send us your CV to consider you for future opportunities.
institutional.hr_desc: To apply for a vacancy or send your CV spontaneously, you can contact our Human Resources department.
institutional.val_1_desc: We fulfill our commitments, ensuring safety and punctuality in every operation.
institutional.val_2_desc: We listen to and understand our clients' needs to offer customized solutions.
institutional.val_3_desc: We act with transparency and ethics in all our commercial and professional relationships.
institutional.val_4_desc: Committed to responsible practices that minimize the environmental impact of our operations.
institutional.spontaneous_desc: Can't find a vacancy that matches your profile? Leave us your CV and we will contact you when an opportunity arises.
institutional.spontaneous_text: Can't find a vacancy that matches your profile? Send us your CV and we will contact you when an opportunity arises.

meta.description: Learn about our history, mission, vision, and values. Join our team of professionals and discover our active vacancies.

institutional.subtitle_full: Who we are, how we work, and how to join the team.
institutional.history_title: An Italian group with over seventy-five years of history
institutional.history_p1: The Atlantic Maritime Group, headquartered in Naples, is one of the leading operators in world shipping. Atlantic Maritime Agency S.A. has represented it locally for over twenty years, with an office in the City of Buenos Aires and operations at Terminal Zárate.
institutional.history_p2: The agency supports exporters, importers, customs brokers and forwarders at every stage: quoting, booking, documentation, shipment, tracking and claims.
institutional.tl_1_text: In Naples, Italy — today one of the leading shipping lines of the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
institutional.tl_2_text: Local representation of the group, with an office in Buenos Aires and operations at Terminal Zárate.
institutional.tl_3_text: Customer Service, Documentation, Finance and Claims, operating from Terminal Zárate.

home.hero_subtitle: Over twenty years representing the Atlantic Maritime Group from Terminal Zárate: ro-ro, project cargo and containers to a network of 130 ports.
home.tc_closed: Outside business hours — view exchange rate
home.vessels_body: In a single call we load vehicles, containers and out-of-gauge cargo. There is no need to wait for a different vessel by cargo type: the ramp and the holds share the same hull.
home.vessels_link: View services and request a quote
home.vessel1_body: Cars, trucks, buses and self-propelled machinery, loaded by ramp with no dismantling or containerization.
home.vessel2_body: Dry and reefer equipment, 20 and 40 feet, with temperature monitoring and connection to the group's network.
home.vessel3_body: Transformers, wind turbine blades and indivisible structures, with dedicated stowage planning.
home.departures_note: Estimated dates, subject to operational and weather conditions.
home.agency_title: We represent the Atlantic Maritime Group in Argentina
home.agency_body: Since 2003 we have operated as the local agency of the Naples-based group, founded in 1947. All of our operations are consolidated at Terminal Zárate, with in-house Customer Service, Documentation, Finance and Claims teams.
home.cta_body: Tell us about your cargo and our commercial team will reply with the rate and available space.

map.intro: Select a service to see its rotation, or hover over a port for its details.

map.svc_eur_note: The agency’s main service: European cargo enters through Zárate.

map.svc_eur_freq_note: Estimated transit of 22 to 26 days to Zárate.
map.svc_asia_note: Chinese cargo reaches Zárate via the southern route, with no European transhipment.
map.svc_asia_rot_note: Taicang, Ningbo, Singapur, Paranaguá, Santos, Montevideo, Zárate.
